## The G9 analysis and the pharmacological half-life {#sec-g9}

```{r g9-text, results = 'asis'}
if (has_g9) {
  g <- bench$g9_compare
  gp <- function(d, h, a, b, m) {
    r <- g[g$design == d & g$t1half == h & abs(g$c_bm_a - a) < 1e-9 &
             abs(g$c_bm_b - b) < 1e-9 & g$method == m, ]
    sprintf('%s (%s)', f3(r$power), f3(r$mcse_power))
  }
  n_g9 <- max(g$n_reps)
  g9w <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    g[g$method %in% c('G9', 'E2cr2'),
      c('design', 't1half', 'c_bm_a', 'c_bm_b', 'method', 'power')],
    names_from = method, values_from = power)
  gnull <- g$power[g$method == 'G9' & g$c_bm_a == 0 & g$c_bm_b == 0]
  cnull <- g$power[g$method == 'E2cr2' & g$c_bm_a == 0 & g$c_bm_b == 0]
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    'G9 chooses the analysis half-life by AIC over 0.25, 0.5, 1 and 2 ',
    'weeks and tests with CR2 [@pmsimstats-paper02]. Its cost is about ',
    'eight E2 fits per trial, so we ran it on the first %d replicates of ',
    'four cells per design and half-life: the null cell and the three ',
    'equal-total pairs. The trials are the same as those of the main run ',
    'under the same seeds, so G9 and E2cr2 are paired. In the null cell ',
    'G9 rejected at %s to %s, against %s to %s for E2cr2 on the same ',
    'trials. The MCSE at the nominal level is %s.\n\n'),
    n_g9, f3(min(gnull)), f3(max(gnull)), f3(min(cnull)), f3(max(cnull)),
    f3(sqrt(0.05 * 0.95 / n_g9))))
  cat('\\begin{table}[H]', '\\small\\centering',
      sprintf(paste0('\\caption{G9 against E2cr2 on the same %d trials ',
                     'per cell, $N = 70$, MCSE in parentheses. G9 chooses ',
                     'the analysis half-life by AIC. E2cr2 uses the true ',
                     'half-life. Mean $\\hat t_{1/2}^a$: the mean half-life ',
                     'G9 chose, in weeks.}'), n_g9),
      '\\label{tab:g9}', '\\begin{tabular}{llrrrrr}', '\\toprule',
      paste0('Design & $t_{1/2}$ & Cell & E2cr2 & G9 & ',
             'Mean $\\hat t_{1/2}^a$ \\\\'),
      '\\midrule', sep = '\n')
  for (d in designs) for (h in hl_main) {
    for (k in list(c(0, 0), c(0.45, 0), c(0.225, 0.225), c(0, 0.45))) {
      r <- g[g$design == d & g$t1half == h & abs(g$c_bm_a - k[1]) < 1e-9 &
               abs(g$c_bm_b - k[2]) < 1e-9 & g$method == 'G9', ]
      cat(sprintf('%s & %s & $(%s, %s)$ & %s & %s & %s \\\\\n',
                  if (h == 0 && all(k == 0)) dname(d) else '',
                  if (all(k == 0)) h else '', k[1], k[2],
                  gp(d, h, k[1], k[2], 'E2cr2'), gp(d, h, k[1], k[2], 'G9'),
                  f2(r$mean_h)))
    }
  }
  cat('\\bottomrule', '\\end{tabular}', '\\end{table}', sep = '\n')
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    '\n\nAt $t_{1/2} = 1$ week in OL+BDC, G9 gave %s at the mean-shift end ',
    'and %s at the correlation end of the equal-total line. E2cr2 gave ',
    '%s and %s on the same trials. In Hybrid, G9 gave %s and %s, and ',
    'E2cr2 gave %s and %s. Over all %d cells, G9 power differed from ',
    'E2cr2 power on the same trials by at most %s. Choosing the half-life ',
    'by AIC therefore cost little power here, and the difference between ',
    'the two ends of the equal-total line remained under G9. G9 cannot ',
    'select $t_{1/2}^a = 0$, since its grid starts at 0.25 week. At ',
    '$t_{1/2} = 0$ it chose a mean half-life of %s to %s week.\n\n'),
    gp('OLBDC', 1, 0.45, 0, 'G9'), gp('OLBDC', 1, 0, 0.45, 'G9'),
    gp('OLBDC', 1, 0.45, 0, 'E2cr2'), gp('OLBDC', 1, 0, 0.45, 'E2cr2'),
    gp('Hybrid', 1, 0.45, 0, 'G9'), gp('Hybrid', 1, 0, 0.45, 'G9'),
    gp('Hybrid', 1, 0.45, 0, 'E2cr2'), gp('Hybrid', 1, 0, 0.45, 'E2cr2'),
    nrow(g9w), f3(max(abs(g9w$G9 - g9w$E2cr2))),
    f2(min(g$mean_h[g$method == 'G9' & g$t1half == 0])),
    f2(max(g$mean_h[g$method == 'G9' & g$t1half == 0]))))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '**RESULTS-PENDING.** The G9 arm had not finished when this ',
    'version was rendered. Command, from the ',
    'repository root: `bash analysis/scripts/dgp-combined/run-combined.sh ',
    '--methods g9 --cells g9 --reps 200 --t1half 0,0.5,1 --gate-reps 0 ',
    '--workers 8 --out-tag -g9`, then rerun `02-summarise-combined.R`. ',
    'Cost: 1800 replicate units of four cells, about 5 CPU-seconds per ',
    'unit, roughly 20 to 30 minutes on eight idle workers.\n\n'))
}
```

```{r hl02-text, results = 'asis'}
if (has_hl02) {
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    'The pharmacological range of the prazosin half-life is 0.1 to 0.2 ',
    'week. We ran the full weight grid at $t_{1/2} = 0.2$ week with %d ',
    'replicates per cell, as a separate pass of the same driver. Its ',
    'validation gate passed in %d further comparisons. Under E2 the null ',
    'cell rejected at %s in CO, ',
    '%s in Hybrid and %s in OL+BDC. At weight 0.45, the mean-shift and ',
    'correlation encodings had power %s and %s in CO, %s and %s in ',
    'Hybrid, and %s and %s in OL+BDC. The paired differences were %s, ',
    '%s and %s. The GLS projection puts the mean-shift overshoot at ',
    '%s to %s percent at this half-life. At pharmacological half-lives ',
    'the two channels are therefore close to interchangeable, and the ',
    'dual-channel architecture adds little to a single encoding.\n\n'),
    n_reps_main, nrow(rd('01-combined-gate-hl02.rds')),
    pw('CO', 0.2, 0, 0), pw('Hybrid', 0.2, 0, 0), pw('OLBDC', 0.2, 0, 0),
    pw('CO', 0.2, 0.45, 0), pw('CO', 0.2, 0, 0.45),
    pw('Hybrid', 0.2, 0.45, 0), pw('Hybrid', 0.2, 0, 0.45),
    pw('OLBDC', 0.2, 0.45, 0), pw('OLBDC', 0.2, 0, 0.45),
    cv('CO', 0.2, 'eqsum_A_minus_B'), cv('Hybrid', 0.2, 'eqsum_A_minus_B'),
    cv('OLBDC', 0.2, 'eqsum_A_minus_B'),
    pct(min(analytic$kappas$overshoot_A[analytic$kappas$t1half == 0.2])),
    pct(max(analytic$kappas$overshoot_A[analytic$kappas$t1half == 0.2]))))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '**RESULTS-PENDING.** The grid at $t_{1/2} = 0.2$ week had not ',
    'finished when this version was rendered. Command: `bash analysis/scripts/dgp-combined/run-combined.sh ',
    '--methods e2 --cells all --reps 1000 --t1half 0.2 --gate-reps 50 ',
    '--workers 8 --out-tag -hl02`, then rerun `02-summarise-combined.R`. ',
    'Cost: 3000 replicate units, about 10 to 15 minutes on eight idle ',
    'workers. The analytic projection (Section \\@ref(sec-analytic)) ',
    'already covers this half-life.\n\n'))
}
```
